# MVTech

> MVTech handles the paper side of owner-operated businesses in the United States. We organize and file every document, track every dollar in and out down to the line item, produce the quotes, invoices and forms a business sends out, and deliver a plain-English operations report on the first of every month. MVTech also acts as a business tech mentor to the owner: a standing weekly session through the first month, and available on request after that.

Last updated: 2026-08-17
Canonical site: https://mvtechusa.com/

## Identity
- Name: MVTech (also written MVTech USA)
- Type: remote document, records and operations service for small owner-operated businesses — engaged like an associate or team member rather than bought like software, with no payroll, W-2 or overhead
- Founder and operator: Michael Vetter, Business Workflow Designer and business tech mentor to the owners MVTech serves
- Serves: the entire United States, remotely
- Part of: MVEnterprises
- What MVTech is NOT: not a CPA firm, not a tax preparer, not a law firm. MVTech organizes records and produces documents; it does not file taxes or give legal advice.

## Contact
- Phone (call or text): 213-444-0024
- Website: https://mvtechusa.com

## What MVTech does
- Document organization — permits, licenses, policies, contracts, vendor accounts, registrations, employee records and contacts, filed and findable in seconds
- Income tracking — every payment received (Zelle, PayPal, Venmo, Stripe, Square, checks) identified and logged as it lands, with recurring payers recognized
- Expense tracking — every receipt and bill captured down to the individual line item, not just the total
- Renewal tracking — license, permit, certification and insurance expiration dates tracked, with a reminder ahead of each date
- Monthly operations reports — plain-English income, expense and trend reporting, ready to hand to a tax preparer, lender or buyer
- Custom document production — quotes, invoices, intake forms, letters, listing sheets and reports, each built to order and produced as polished, branded PDFs in the client's own brand
- Form conversion and document merge — a photo or scan becomes a clean custom fillable form; a stack of forms becomes one packet filled from a single entry
- Advertising support (à la carte) — ads written, posted and kept running; graphics and flyers produced on request
- Deep-dive research reports (à la carte) — sourced, cited, decision-ready research on a market, competitor or business question

## The core differentiator: itemization
A bank feed or card statement records that a business spent $214 at a supply store. MVTech records what was actually in the cart, line by line, because it reads the receipt itself. That level of detail is what bank feeds, card statements and store apps discard, and it is what makes job costing, category detail and clean tax preparation possible.

## How it works
1. One onboarding call walks through how the business actually runs, at the client's pace. MVTech builds the client's folder, dashboard and document set around that.
2. The owner keeps working exactly as before. Bills and receipts already arriving by email become line items on their own; anything on paper can be photographed and it is read and filed.
3. On the first of each month the owner receives an operations report plus organized, professional documents. Renewal dates surface on the dashboard before they come due.

There is no app to install and no new system to learn. Spreadsheets open directly in Excel or Google Sheets; documents live in an ordinary folder the client owns.

## Who this is for
Owner-operators who wear every hat, generally under about six employees: trades and contractors, food trucks and small restaurants, used car lots, solo attorneys and other professional practices, event organizers, and owners selling property For Sale By Owner. Best fit is a business whose records currently live in a pile, a truck, a drawer, or the owner's head.

## Pricing
- One-time onboarding: $495 — full setup, document intake and first-month buildout, paid before any monthly billing begins
- The monthly plan: $249 per month — dashboard on desktop and phone, document filing, itemized income and expense tracking, renewal dates surfaced before they come due, plain-English monthly report, a standing 90-minute session every week through the first month and on request after that, and personal support from MVTech
- À la carte, on top of the plan or on their own: ads written/posted/kept running, graphics, flyers, custom documents, listing sheets, form builds and deep-dive research reports — single projects, priced one at a time

There is one plan at one flat price. No hourly billing, no per-document charges, no contract and no term — the client can stop at the end of any month, and MVTech works the same way. Tiered plans may return later; today there is one.

## Trust and access
- The client owns everything. Records are kept in ordinary formats (spreadsheets and PDFs) in a folder that belongs to the client — ready to hand over when they need to prove income, apply for financing, or give a preparer a finished year.
- Every document that goes out is personally reviewed by Michael Vetter.

## Common questions
Q: What does MVTech do?
A: It handles the paper side of an owner-operated business — filing every document, tracking every dollar in and out line by line, producing the documents the business sends out, and delivering a plain-English report on the first of each month.

Q: How much does it cost?
A: A one-time $495 onboarding, then $249 per month. One plan, one price, month to month.

Q: Can I buy a single project instead of a monthly plan?
A: Yes. Single projects — a form, a flyer, a document build, a research report — are available à la carte, alongside the monthly plan or on their own.

Q: Do I have to learn new software?
A: No. Nothing to install, nothing to log into. Spreadsheets open in Excel or Google Sheets.

Q: How is this different from a bookkeeper or accounting software?
A: MVTech captures itemized receipt detail that bank feeds discard, and it also handles documents, renewals and outgoing paperwork. It is not a CPA firm and does not file taxes; it hands a tax preparer clean, finished numbers.

Q: Do I own my records?
A: Yes, entirely, in ordinary formats — ready to use whenever proof of income or tax preparation calls for them.

Q: Where does MVTech work?
A: Anywhere in the United States. All work is remote.

Q: How do I start?
A: Call or text 213-444-0024 and ask for Michael. The first conversation is free.
